input: Knit a chunky blanket for the nursery

gold.taskTitle: Knit a Chunky Blanket for the Nursery
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to knit a chunky blanket intended for a nursery setting.

questions.title: What are the target finished dimensions of the blanket?
questions.description: Clarify the desired length and width of the completed blanket.

questions.title: What yarn weight and fiber type do you have in mind?
questions.description: Understand whether the user has a specific yarn in mind, such as super bulky wool, acrylic, or a blend.

questions.title: What color or color scheme should the blanket be?
questions.description: Determine the preferred colors to match the nursery decor or theme.

questions.title: Do you already have yarn, needles, or a pattern purchased?
questions.description: Find out what materials the user already has on hand versus what still needs to be sourced.

questions.title: What is your current knitting skill level?
questions.description: Gauge whether the user is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced knitter to tailor pattern and stitch recommendations.

questions.title: Is there a deadline, such as a due date or baby shower?
questions.description: Identify any time constraint that should shape the project timeline and complexity.

questions.title: Should the blanket be arm-knit, needle-knit, or loom-knit?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred knitting method, as chunky blankets are commonly made with all three techniques.
